causal_confidence.statement: The authors call Ser50del the most likely familial cause, report its absence in250 normal controls, and report altered transcriptional activation/phosphorylation consistent with prior NRL variants. These family and experimental observations support their candidate interpretation; they do not independently establish clinical truth or exclude every alternative.

limitations: Single-family evidence and reported assays are not independent replication.
